rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for religious worship, including devotion and a worship service in a church context.

example.english: We will go to church for worship this Sunday.
example.traditional: 今個星期日我哋會去教會參加崇拜。
example.jyutping: gam1 go3 sing1 kei4 jat6 ngo5 dei6 wui5 heoi3 gaau3 wui2 caam1 gaa1 sung4 baai3

rows.note: Use this especially for devotional worship of God, particularly in Christian contexts, rather than for the service itself.

example.traditional: 我每日朝早都會敬拜上帝。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 dou1 wui5 ging3 baai3 soeng6 dai3

rows.note: Use this for the popular or traditional practice of worshipping deities, rather than for a formal religious service.

example.english: We worship the gods together during Lunar New Year.
example.traditional: 農曆新年，我哋一家人會一齊拜神。
example.jyutping: nung4 lik6 san1 nin4 ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 wui5 jat1 cai4 baai3 san4
